elements.char: at the center of every galaxy, including our own Milky
elements.label: text

elements.char: Way.

elements.char: Therefore, one can compute observable quanti-
elements.label: text

elements.char: ties that can be measured directly with either current
elements.label: text

elements.char: or near-future instruments.
elements.label: text

elements.char: These observational exper-
elements.label: text

elements.char: iments allow for the formulation of a GTR test in the

elements.label: text

elements.char: a black hole, there must be no deviation from the Kerr
elements.label: text

elements.char: metric. If, however, the deviation is measured to be dif-
elements.label: text

elements.char: ferent from zero, then it indicates that either the central
elements.label: text

elements.char: object is of a different type, or that the GTR itself breaks
elements.label: text

elements.char: down at the strong gravitational regime very close to the
elements.label: text

elements.char: event horizon of the BH. However, one should always
elements.label: text

elements.char: keep in mind that the Kerr BH solution to the GTR field

elements.char: equations is indistinguishable from exact solutions of a
elements.label: text

elements.char: tor and tensor degrees of freedom to the Einstein-Hilbert

elements.char: action [24].
